label: Counting literals
subgoals: Count each variable occurrence in each cube, complemented or not
Sum the literal counts over all cubes of the cover
Count leaf occurrences when the expression is a factored form

label: Two-input gate count
subgoals: Charge l - 1 two-input ANDs for a cube with l literals
Charge k - 1 two-input ORs for k cubes
Use the identity that the total equals literals minus one

label: Depth as the delay proxy
subgoals: Compute a balanced tree depth as the ceiling of log base 2 of its width
Add the product depth and the sum depth for a two-level form
Weigh depth against literal count when a transformation trades one for the other
